name: Reunification Palace
kicker: Palace on the old Norodom site
summary: Palace on the old Norodom site: walk the halls and the basement command rooms, open 07:00–18:00. Ngô Viết Thụ designed the building you enter, at 135 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa. Palace-only is 40,000 đồng on the August 2025 ticket page. On that page, 80,000 đồng is the palace plus the exhibition. The homepage also prints 80,000 đồng for an adult.
fee: 40,000 đồng palace-only on the 2025 ticket page. The homepage prints 80,000.
getThere: Walk from Đồng Khởi or Nguyễn Huệ. Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The facade, the lawn, and the fountain

notice.title: 80,000 đồng is not one ticket
notice.body: On the ticket page applied from 1 August 2025, 80,000 đồng is the palace plus the exhibition. Palace-only is 40,000 đồng. The homepage also prints 80,000 đồng for an adult. Vietnam Tourism prints 15,000 đồng inside a block it repeats on several sights. Do not treat that 15,000 as the chosen price.

body: The building you walk was designed by Ngô Viết Thụ on the site of Dinh Norodom. The historical mark is 30 April 1975. In 1976 the building was called Hội trường Thống Nhất, and the operator’s homepage still uses that name for the managing body. The Norodom start is dated 23 February 1868, finished in 1871. The special-national ranking is Decision 1272/QĐ-TTg of 12 August 2009, after a national ranking by Decision 77A/VHQĐ of 25 June 1976. The homepage counter reads 120,000 square metres and more than 3,700 objects.

The basement command center and the war rooms are the part to keep time for. One suggested order is the Norodom display of 1868 first, then the rooms of the 1966 building. Cà phê sữa đá in the park outside, on a Saturday morning, is before you go in. That coffee is outside the ticket.

gettingThere: The addresses on the operator pages are 135 Nam Kỳ Khởi Nghĩa and 106 Nguyễn Du, Phường Bến Thành. Vietnam Tourism says 135 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia, Ben Thanh, District 1. The ward and the older district label both stay. From Đồng Khởi or Nguyễn Huệ you walk. Visit HCMC prints about 2.7 km from the Jade Emperor Pagoda. Check on arrival.

hours: Both operator pages print visiting 07:00–18:00 every day. The 2025 ticket page adds that gate 135 sells tickets 07:00–18:00 and gate 106 sells 08:00–16:00, including holidays unless a special notice says otherwise. Vietnam Tourism prints 7:30 a.m.–12 p.m. and 1:30–5 p.m. on this sight and on several others. That split clock stays on the record and is not the chosen hour.
closed: No weekly closing day is printed. A special notice can close the building.
admissionNote: Ticket page, applied from 1 August 2025. Combo “Hành Trình Trọn Vẹn,” palace plus exhibition plus buggy: adult 105,000 đồng, age 60 or over or a Vietnamese student 65,000, child 6–17 45,000. Combo “Hành Trình Lịch Sử,” palace plus exhibition: adult 80,000, age 60 or a Vietnamese student 40,000, child 6–17 20,000. Combo “Trải Nghiệm Tiện Lợi,” palace plus buggy: adult 65,000, age 60 or a Vietnamese student 45,000, child 6–17 35,000. Combined palace and exhibition: adult 80,000, Vietnamese student 40,000, child 20,000. Palace only: adult 40,000, Vietnamese student 20,000, child 10,000. Buggy 25,000 đồng a ride. A guide from 350,000 đồng. Photo permission from 1,000,000 đồng. “Khám phá Di sản” from 20,000 đồng. The homepage prints a shorter block: adult 80,000, student or older person 40,000, child from 6 to under 16 20,000. The child band 6–17 and the band from 6 to under 16 both stay. Vietnam Tourism prints 15,000 VND. That figure stays and is not chosen.
